plan.title: Live RFQ Edit Evaluation Time Cancel

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on its Responses tab as required for prepared-state cases.
Confirm the event is still live before opening the dialog.
Confirm the prepared event has no bids before cancellation.
Open the Edit Evaluation Time dialog from the RFQ Settings menu.
Verify that the expected evaluation-time window opened.
Cancel the dialog without saving any change.
Verify that cancelling closes the Edit Evaluation Time window.
Verify the event remains live after cancellation.
Verify the no-bid state remains unchanged after cancellation.
